Resolves #19664

A height change above the row at the top of a content-sized grid now moves the scroll offset along with it, so the visible rows hold still. `grid.View#setRowHeights` measures how far the anchor row (the row at the scroll offset) moves. It sends that distance as `scrollCorrection` in the View's update meta, next to `scrollTop`. `GridRowScrollPinning` applies it in the same task as the deltas, relative to the offset before them. It ignores an acknowledgement older than the last correction (`scrollEpoch`). During a thumb drag, height changes wait for the release, so the extent under the thumb stays still. A content-sized grid registers the addon even without row pinning, so corrections still apply.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e on a fixture that learns heights as rows render; unit arms; mutation checks) → L3 required (on-screen positions are browser-observable). Residual: none for the ACs; a pre-existing scrollbar-track mismatch is noted under Deltas.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the commit hooks' whitespace, shorthand, jsdoc-types, ticket-archaeology, block-alignment, parse, fixed-sleeps and class-module-scope lints ran clean.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 a correction above the visible record keeps its on-screen position | e2e `grid/AnchorCorrection.spec.mjs` › "rows that grow / shrink above the view keep the row at its top edge still, mid-list / at the end of the list" (4 arms; the row's position is sampled on every animation frame); unit `grid/AnchorCorrection.spec.mjs` › "a change above the anchor row moves the scroll offset along…", "a change below the anchor row moves nothing" |
| AC-2 Sophie's ordering race converges in both orders | unit `main/addon/GridRowScrollPinning.spec.mjs` › "pinning converges when a correction and an older acknowledgement arrive correction first" and "… older acknowledgement first" |
| AC-3 the extent holds during a thumb drag and settles at release; the final row stays reachable | e2e › "a thumb drag holds the extent until its release, and the final row stays reachable"; unit › "during a thumb drag the heights wait and the extent holds still, and its end applies them" |
| AC-4 reverse wheel scrolling over freshly measured rows shows no jump | e2e › "scrolling up over rows learned on the way shows no jump at the top edge" |

## Deltas from ticket

- **The correction lands after the deltas, not before them** (ticket step 3). Before the deltas, the bodies still have the old extent, and the browser clamped a growth at the end of the list (the e2e's top row jumped 1664px). `Neo.main.DeltaUpdates` now fires `updated` once a batch has applied. The addon reads the target in `update` and applies it in `updated`. A grown extent admits it, and the clamp from a shrunk extent is not counted twice.
- **The rows travel with their correction.** A smaller row lowers the geometry's minimum height, which grows the row pool. `Body#afterSetAvailableRows` rendered that in a body update of its own, without the meta (one frame 832px off mid-list, a double move at the end). `View#refreshRowGeometry` now renders the pool change in the View's update.
- **The vertical scrollbar's extent is ordered around the correction.** `ScrollSync` copies the scrollbar's offset into the view, so a scrollbar clamped by a smaller extent pulled the view ahead of the correction. Its extent now grows before the View's update and shrinks after it, and waits when the View defers a busy update.
- **The correction also survives an absorbed View update** (review round 1). When an ancestor's update absorbs the View's payload, `Neo.mixin.VdomLifecycle` sends the View's meta along with that batch, keyed by the View's id, and `Neo.vdom.Helper#updateBatch` merges it in. Before, the meta was read and then dropped with the absorbed payload, so the correction was lost.
- **A store replacement drops the heights held during a thumb drag** (review round 1). They are keyed by the old store's records.
- **A reset of the measured heights keeps the visible row still, too** (after #19672 landed). `View#resetRowHeights`, which a wrapText change runs, cleared every height without the anchor, so the visible row jumped. It now shares the private `#changeRowHeights` with `setRowHeights`.
- **`unregister` removes the drag listeners from the scrollbar**, where `register` added them, instead of from the wrapper.
- Out of scope, noted in defect-note `MESSAGE:22412820`: the vertical scrollbar's track runs 15px into the horizontal scrollbar's row, so it ends 15px before the view does. At the very end of a shrinking list, only `ScrollSync`'s 50ms lock drops the resulting clamp.

## Test Evidence

- Mutation checks, each reverted afterwards:
  - correction applied before the deltas → the grow-at-the-end, shrink-at-the-end and thumb-release arms fail;
  - pool change rendered by the body → both shrink arms fail (a frame at −832 mid-list; 645 instead of −187 at the end), and unit "a smaller row grows the row pool…" fails;
  - scrollbar extent always first → shrink at the end fails (−172 instead of −187, 3 of 3), and unit "the scrollbar extent grows before…" fails;
  - shrink not waiting for a busy View → unit "a busy view defers…" fails;
  - no hold during a thumb drag → the thumb arm fails (extent 13584 instead of 10992);
  - correction never written to the DOM → 5 of 6 e2e arms fail. Shrink at the end passes, because there the browser's clamp equals the correction;
  - absorbed meta not forwarded → unit "when an ancestor update absorbs the view update…" fails (0 batches carry the correction);
  - held heights kept across a store replacement → unit "heights held during a thumb drag do not outlive a store replacement…" fails (160 instead of 40);
  - the reset without the anchor → unit "a reset of the measured heights keeps the anchor row still" fails (the anchor moves 80px).

Without the drop, new record 10 gets 160px.
